name: Napoleon Bonaparte
original_name: ナポレオン・ボナパルト
source:
One of the greatest and most controversial leaders in history, Napoleon has a natural aura that drives people to him. He strongly feels that all people are born equally, and should be treated as such. 
Unlike the others, he has no Idea why he ended up in the mansion. 

"Tell me... Can you do the unspeakable?"
